name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Tree.key_mul
title: Tree-encoding key invariant is preserved by multiplication
statement: Let G be k x n, Z be k x N, M_f, M_g be n x n and H_f, H_g be N x n matrices over a commutative ring, and f, g scalars. If G M_f - Z H_f = f G and G M_g - Z H_g = g G (the invariant (17) of Tree Encodings I at a fixed input alpha), then G (M_f M_g) - Z (H_f M_g + f H_g) = (f g) G. This is the correctness of Lemma 10 (multiplication) of Abram-Malavolta-Roy (ePrint 2026/741).
